protocol.classification: stored legacy spatial-path threshold labels; no new significance classification
protocol.control_pool: all non-PGC units; same count matched on independently calibrated mean and RMS activity
protocol.perturbation: same 1%-norm multiplicative rate disturbance, orthogonal to state scaling; not claimed to be an empirical manifold normal
protocol.stability_reference: perturbed and unperturbed trajectories under the identical gated recurrence
protocol.gating: selected source-unit output into recurrence only; input/encoder/decoder and initial states unchanged
protocol.readout_only_control: native recurrence; PGC contribution masked only when computing original decoder output
